mapper.select:
SELECT status, count(*) as count FROM club WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND DATE(create_time) >= DATE(#{beginTime})
AND DATE(create_time) <= DATE(#{endTime})
GROUP BY status

SELECT count(*) FROM club WHERE del_flag = '0' AND is_recruiting = '1'
AND DATE(create_time) >= DATE(#{beginTime})
AND DATE(create_time) <= DATE(#{endTime})

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM club WHERE del_flag='0' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) as totalNew, (SELECT count(*) FROM club WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) as activeNew, (SELECT count(*) FROM club WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='1' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) as disabledNew, (SELECT count(*) FROM club WHERE del_flag='0' AND is_recruiting='1' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) as recruitingNew
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as count FROM club WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT cc.category_name as categoryName, cc.category_id as categoryId, count(*) as count FROM club c LEFT JOIN club_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY cc.category_name, cc.category_id ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT c.club_name as clubName, c.club_id as clubId, c.member_count as memberCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM club_activity a WHERE a.club_id = c.club_id AND a.del_flag = '0') as activityCount FROM club c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.member_count DESC LIMIT 10
